description: Ground-truth labels for cmd/truthset (D161): one row per (installed package, CVE) whose expected verdict is the distro's own statement at source.fetchedAt. class=matcher rows feed precision/recall; class=data rows are known data gaps, reported but excluded from the metrics. Seeded 2026-11-09 from the 2026-11-04 QA boundary harness (32 cases, 84 checks, 3 families). Debian:11 matcher-class labels carry validFrom 2026-08-19, the key's D110 freeze date: the 2026-11-04 harness verified them against that frozen snapshot, so that is the earliest data they are known to hold at; the data-class rows keep 2026-10-28 and are PREDATES while the key is frozen (their DLAs came after the freeze). expect.fixed is spelled as the provider's own record spells the fix, which is what a finding's evidence.fixed carries: Red Hat CSAF with the epoch (0:2.34-168.el9_6.19), AlmaLinux's OSV with a non-zero epoch only (1:3.2.2-6.el9_5.1), OSV's Go records without the v prefix (0.45.0) while the purl and the label version keep it (v0.33.0). Expanded 2026-11-09 with 56 labels in six new families (rhel, alma, amzn, wolfi, npm, go) researched from the upstreams' own advisories and adversarially re-verified; the amzn labels predate the 2026-11-08 database's Amazon Linux 2023 date (2025-03-06, D113's pre-revision KeyAsOf) and judge from the first database built after D113 revised (PR #254).
